newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony says develops new large-capacity MD format.
newsitem.headline: Sony says develops new large-capacity MD format.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Monday that it had developed a new MiniDisc (MD) with a storage capacity more than four times larger than the existing version.
The new "Quadruple Density MD" has a single-disc data storage capacity of 650 megabytes, about 4.6 times larger than the original MD format, the company said in a statement.
Sony and Sharp Corp cooperated in developing the new format and will approach other companies in the industry regarding the adoption of the new technology, the statement said.
A Sony spokesman said that new products based on the new format were expected to hit the market by the end of 1997.
